project.title: Glitching Materiality - @THEVOID
project.description: Algorithmic performance: a real-time, live-coded visual system for the Institute of Network Cultures.
project.introText: A live coding performance with Karolis Lasys at Expanded Publishing Fest 2: Space-in / Space-out, organized by the Institute of Network Cultures in Amsterdam in 2024.
project.middleText: The visuals were live-coded in Hydra Video Synth. The recording, about 18 minutes long, is published by the Institute of Network Cultures.
project.highlightCaption: Still from the recording: archive photographs of early computers under live-coded text, around the word 'Material'.
project.context: Expanded Publishing Fest 2: Space-in / Space-out, Institute of Network Cultures, Amsterdam

summary.brief: A live audiovisual performance for the Institute of Network Cultures' Expanded Publishing Fest 2.
summary.role: Live-coded visuals, performing with Karolis Lasys.
summary.method: Hydra sketches written and rewritten in real time, responding to the other performer's sound.
summary.outcome: An 18-minute performance, recorded and published by the Institute of Network Cultures.

facts: live set, published by the INC
project.shows: Real-time interactive systems and collaboration: visuals generated and rewritten live, in dialogue with another performer.
project.embedCaption: The full recording, published by the Institute of Network Cultures.

decisions.choice: Write the visuals live in Hydra rather than play prepared material.
decisions.why: So they could respond to Karolis Lasys’s sound as it happened.
decisions.result: An 18-minute performance in dialogue, recorded and published by the Institute of Network Cultures.
